question: Does a fixed BTC ETH or SOL Binance-versus-OKX USDT perpetual orientation retain positive direction-neutral funding carry in training validation and test after all frozen hurdles?

official_semantics.api: OKX API v5 documents public GET /api/v5/public/funding-rate-history, up to three months of history, limit 400, and realizedRate at fundingTime.
official_semantics.cash_flow: OKX official funding terms state positive funding is paid by longs to shorts and negative funding is paid by shorts to longs, matching Binance signed-rate orientation.
official_semantics.fee_source: OKX official current standard Lv1 USDT perpetual examples use 0.02 percent maker and 0.05 percent taker per fill; the frozen execution hurdle is deliberately not zero.

population.inventory_gate: Each exact OKX instId must occur once with instType SWAP, ctType linear, settleCcy USDT, state live, and listTime no later than the first frozen funding bucket.

orientation: Choose sign once from the training aggregate of OKX realizedRate minus Binance fundingRate. A positive training aggregate fixes short OKX and long Binance; a negative aggregate fixes long OKX and short Binance. Never refit validation or test.

decision.failure: Terminalize the exact 90-bin population before premiums books accounts credentials orders or funds; do not resample or alter roles orientation alignment or costs.
decision.survivor: Freeze a separate synchronized finite-size entry and exit basis/depth study. A survivor is not yet an accepted edge or deployment-ready.

retry_policy: One inventory GET and one funding GET per asset only. Preserve every terminal response. Never paginate alias reorder narrow substitute a host or retry after seeing values.
